title: AI's Big Challenges: Copyright & Hallucination
description: Generative AI faces challenges like copyright issues and hallucinations, which can lead to ethical concerns, misinformation, and legal conflicts. Mitigation strategies include licensing agreements, fact-checking, improved datasets, and human oversight to balance innovation with responsibility.

title: Generative AI's Ethical Dilemmas Unveiled
description: Generative AI holds transformative potential but raises critical ethical concerns, including transparency, copyright, bias, data privacy risks, and intellectual property rights. Addressing these challenges requires robust regulations and collaborative efforts to ensure responsible development and deployment.
